tools.name: find_companies
tools.description: Search the ~380 US consumer companies covered, by name or ticker (free). Returns ISIN, ticker, name, tier (1 largest, 3 smallest, weekly only) and the first and last day of data.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Q1 2019 daily (or weekly) sales, units and panel stores for one company, free, to see what the data looks like.

tools.name: get_yoy_growth
tools.description: Year-on-year growth in a company's point-of-sale sales and units, $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base): its latest reported quarter (91 days to its end; never the one it hasn't reported) against the same weekdays a year earlier, same store and like for like, for the company and for every sale in those stores,

tools.name: quote_sales
tools.description: The exact price of a window of daily or weekly sales and units (free), and the HTTP URL to buy it from with x402.
